_doc: Generated by a scratch script from the concept layout (the mill scene at the east bank around (1120, 1000)); explicit water props carry dy so they sit on the river surface.

place._: The concept view: the east-bank watermill (wheel in the current), looking downstream past the shoal to the stone arch bridge, with the fishing dock and rowing boat on the west bank.
Banks: weeping willows and birches in clusters at the concept spot.
Mill yard: crates, cart, bench, fence; lanterns at the bridge ends.
Footbridges where the lanes cross the brook.
The meadow pond: lily pads, cattails, reeds.
Willowford farm (south-west, by the Bellmere road): barn, silo, shed, well, hay, fields.
The hamlet at the road end: two cottages, a shed, a well, lamps.
Hollins farm (east bank): barn, shed, hay, cart, fields and an orchard.
Hay meadow on the west bank, hedged.
A fisher hut on the north bank, the willow lane to the falls.
